method: headless Chrome over CDP; getComputedStyle read after the interaction settled (>=0.7s); *_samples read opacity/transform at t ms after the trigger to capture the keyframe animation curve; pointer via Input.dispatchMouseEvent (desktop) and Input.dispatchTouchEvent (mobile). Cookie banner (Complianz) refused first; it overlays the page and swallows the first click.

catalog_panel.opens_on: click (desktop, hover does NOT open it; Bootstrap dropdown, button gets aria-expanded=true and ul gets .show) / tap (mobile)

desktop.observed: opacity 0 -> 1 and translateY(511px = 100% of panel height) -> 0 over ~0.3s

mobile.opens_on: tap on the chevron button (row link navigates)
mobile.position: fixed, covers the drawer at 0,0 width 360

catalog_trigger.caret: ::after svg chevron, transform none closed and open

tile.rest_vs_hover: no computed change on the tile itself (transform none, box-shadow none, border-color rgb(0,0,0) at rest and hover); image transform none too

not_measured: mobile hover states for tile, Vezi produse button, product card: touch has no hover; tapping would navigate, so only rest values recorded
keyframe definitions (fadeInUp/fadeInRight/fadeInLeft) were not read from the stylesheet; their effect was sampled instead (see *_samples)
